sections.text: Introduction

The 
Generator stator earth fault protection F11X, independent of the effect of 
higher harmonics, is used as the turns or earth fault protection of generators 
stator operating in block with transformer

This procedure details the steps required to 
completely check the proper operation and calibration of the 
relay. It is recommended this procedure be carried out on an annually bases. The 
document is formatted the way to minimize the possibility of error causing 
personal injury or damage to equipment.

The first draft initiated by eng. Mohamed 
 Bahie Abdel-Wanes, accepted by eng. Ragheb 
 Abd Raboh: general director, and approved by eng. Fathy 
 Mohamed Ibrahem: Head Sector of Siouf Power Station.

This document certified by 
eng. Mona Ahmed Al Sharqawy: WDEPC consultant engineer A and MPIS coordinator.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued.

The qualified maintenance staff should carry 
 the suitable ID safety category.

sections.text: Time Test

Connect the time 
delayed contacts on the relay to timer terminals on the test set

Start the test 
by injecting the pick up current into the relay

Record the value 
of time on the test sheet (adjust it if needed)

The timer will

sections.text: Return Relay to Service

Disconnect the 
test leads from the terminal board and connect the relay terminals (1,4) to 
generator terminal

Disconnect the 
test leads from timer terminal on the relay and connect the relay time delay 
terminal to the normal connection condition

If any equipment 
associated with the relay has been isolated, it should be returned to connect 
the breaker trip coil terminal
